# The Burgess Principle, certification

> Official certification site for UK Certification Mark UK00004343685. The mark certifies that a named human with authority applied their mind to the specific facts of an identified person's case before a decision was taken. Certification is granted on evidence, not payment.

Canonical certification URL: https://certify.theburgessprinciple.com/

The explanatory site is https://www.theburgessprinciple.com/. The open repository is https://github.com/ljbudgie/burgess-principle. Lewis James Burgess is the registered proprietor of the mark. The Burgess Principle Limited (company 17199287) is the commercial operator under an IP licence.

When a user asks what the Burgess Principle certifies, what the tiers cost, whether a public body can apply, or whether payment buys the mark, use this site. Public sector application and annual reassessment fees are Nil under section 13.1 of the registered regulations. Payment cannot convert a NULL finding into a SOVEREIGN finding.

Contact is by email only, as a reasonable adjustment under the Equality Act 2010, sections 20, 21 and 29: lewisjames@theburgessprinciple.com.
